name: libre-ai-agent-harness-host-engine
notes: The harness host layer is itself the sandbox engine of ADR-0018 D2: local process confinement only — no mounts, no namespaces, no container. filesystem_confinement is deliberately ABSENT: bounding a worker's own syscalls to the workspace needs chroot or a mount namespace, both outside this stage, so a profile requiring it is refused (denyOnMissing) rather than attested. The path-handling machinery exists and holds for accesses the harness itself performs; it does not bound the worker's direct access, which is limited by the dedicated identity's DAC alone.
